SELECT cs.cancer_study_identifier AS study_id, assumeNotNull(r.PATIENT_ID) AS patient_id,
upper(trimBoth(JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.METADATA, '{}'), 'slide_type'))) AS stored_slide_type, multiIf( JSONExtractBool(ifNull(r.METADATA, '{}'), 'is_ihc'), 'IHC', JSONExtractBool(ifNull(r.METADATA, '{}'), 'is_hne'), 'H&E', stored_slide_type = 'IHC', 'IHC', stored_slide_type IN ('H&E', 'HE'), 'H&E', stored_slide_type = 'UNKNOWN', 'Unknown', 'Other' ) AS stain_group, JSONExtractBool(ifNull(r.METADATA, '{}'), 'can_serve_tiles') AS viewable, multiIf( r.SAMPLE_ID IS NULL, 'UNMATCHED', JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.METADATA, '{}'), 'match_level') IN ('PART', 'UNMATCHED'), JSONExtractString(ifNull(r.METADATA, '{}'), 'match_level'), 'BLOCK' ) AS match_level FROM resource_data r INNER JOIN cancer_study cs ON cs.cancer_study_id = r.CANCER_STUDY_ID PREWHERE r.CANCER_STUDY_ID IN ( SELECT cancer_study_id FROM cancer_study WHERE cancer_study_identifier IN #{studyId} ) WHERE r.RESOURCE_ID IN ('WSI_SAMPLE', 'WSI_PATIENT') AND r.TYPE = 'WHOLE_SLIDE_IMAGE' AND r.PATIENT_ID IS NOT NULL AND concat(cs.cancer_study_identifier, '_', assumeNotNull(r.PATIENT_ID)) IN ( SELECT patient_unique_id FROM sample_derived WHERE sample_unique_id IN () )
AND JSONExtractBool(ifNull(r.METADATA, '{}'), 'can_serve_tiles')
AND ( positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(assumeNotNull(r.PATIENT_ID), #{query.search}) > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(ifNull(r.SAMPLE_ID, ''), #{query.search}) > 0 )
AND match_level IN #{matchLevel}

SELECT uniqExactIf((study_id, patient_id), ) AS total_patients, countIf() AS total_slides, countIf(viewable AND ) AS total_viewable_slides, countIf(stain_group = 'H&E') AS hne, countIf(stain_group = 'IHC') AS ihc, countIf(stain_group = 'Other') AS other, countIf(stain_group = 'Unknown') AS unknown
, uniqExactIf( (study_id, patient_id),
AND (study_id, patient_id) < (#{query.locateStudyId}, #{query.locatePatientId}) ) AS located_index, countIf(
AND study_id = #{query.locateStudyId} AND patient_id = #{query.locatePatientId} ) > 0 AS located
FROM ()

SELECT study_id, patient_id, count() AS slide_count, countIf(viewable) AS viewable_slide_count, countIf(stain_group = 'H&E') AS hne, countIf(stain_group = 'IHC') AS ihc, countIf(stain_group = 'Other') AS other, countIf(stain_group = 'Unknown') AS unknown FROM () WHERE GROUP BY study_id, patient_id ORDER BY study_id, patient_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT attribute_id, value, patient_count, value_count FROM ( SELECT attribute_name AS attribute_id, attribute_value AS value, uniqExact(patient_unique_id) AS patient_count, count() OVER (PARTITION BY attribute_name) AS value_count FROM clinical_data_derived WHERE cancer_study_identifier IN #{studyId} AND attribute_name IN #{attributeId} AND upper(attribute_value) NOT IN ('NA', '') AND patient_unique_id IN ( SELECT concat(study_id, '_', patient_id) FROM () WHERE ) GROUP BY attribute_name, attribute_value ) ORDER BY attribute_id, patient_count DESC, value LIMIT #{maxValues} BY attribute_id
SELECT match_level, uniqExact((study_id, patient_id)) AS patient_count FROM () WHERE GROUP BY match_level
